inlines.v: HOWL'ING, participle present tense Uttering the cry of a dog or wolf; uttering a loud cry of distress. HOWL'ING, adjective Filled with howls, or howling beasts; dreary. Innumerable artifices and stratagems are acted in the howling wilderness and in the great deep, that can never come to our knowledge. HOWL'ING, noun The act of howling; a loud outcry or mournful sound.
